action_description: 16-frame in-place run. Frame 1 stays unchanged; 2-8 form the first stride and brief airborne phase, 9 is opposite contact, and 10-16 form the second stride and return smoothly.
locked_constraints: animate in place with no horizontal travel
preserve outfit, equipment, proportions, and palette
keep the full character inside the canvas
loop_constraint: The last frame must flow into frame 1 with continuous stride timing and momentum.
